usedFor: SuperSaaS holds appointments, and Microsoft Excel logs them in a table with “Add Row To Table” when “New Appointment” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new appointment becomes a row in an Excel table, ready to sort and share.

watchOut: “Send Mail” in SuperSaaS switches off regular sending, so test it before you point “Add Row To Table” at it.
